messages:
Maya (PM): quick thread — proposing a 6-week pilot cohort for the new Design Partner flow. goal: validate onboarding, feedback cadence, and success metrics before broader beta. looking for alignment on recruitment, survey cadence, and what success looks like.
Evan (Design): +1. can we target 8-10 partners with mixed use-cases (chat, embeddings, rerank)? keeps feedback manageable.
Priya (Eng): ok but need to surface infra requirements early. can we tag partners by expected QPS + model family so we can provision dedicated slots?
Jules (CS): i can reach out to 7 existing customers who asked for lower latency routing. will double-check legal for NDAs.
Maya (PM): rough cohort mix proposal: 4 product teams (chat-heavy), 3 data teams (embedding/rerank), 3 infra/platform. target regions: NA + EU.
Liam (Growth): suggest one PLG power-user who tried hosted api at scale — good to have a noisy case. i'll pull contact.
Evan (Design): proposed feedback loop: weekly 30m session + short asynchronous survey after each session. also capture 3 canonical tasks per partner we can run evals on. sample survey snippet: ```1) How often did you hit latency SLOs? (never/sometimes/always) 2) How clear was onboarding (1-5)? 3) Any blocking issues?```
Priya (Eng): ops ask: please include peak concurrency and token/sec estimates in the intake. i'll create a tiny YAML template we can attach.
Maya (PM): MVP success criteria (draft): - 80% of partners complete 4/6 sessions - show measurable latency improvement or stable error rates vs baseline - actionable product changes prioritized (>=3 items) - onboarding docs reduced time-to-first-call by 30%
Jules (CS): add customer satisfaction: NPS-style question at end of pilot + willingness to be case study (opt-in).
ops-bot: Reminder — run security intake for cohorts with private data. https://redwood-infra/security-intake
Priya (Eng): timeline: recruitment week 1, onboarding week 2 (guided), pilot weeks 3-8, wrap + synthesis week 9. need commit from eng on canary/dev slots by end of recruitment week.
Maya (PM): volunteers: who will own recruitment outreach copy? who runs weekly synth notes?
Jules (CS): i'll own outreach copy and NDAs.
Evan (Design): i'll run weekly sessions and capture UX notes + artifacts.
Liam (Growth): i'll coordinate incentives (credits + swag) and handle case-study permissions.
Priya (Eng): i'll own infra provisioning and the intake template. putting a quick intake draft in the product drive after this.
Maya (PM): nice. next steps: i'll draft the recruitment email and intake form by EOD tomorrow and post here. tagging folks: @Evan (Design) @Priya (Eng) @Jules (CS) @Liam (Growth) — please flag any blockers. :thumbsup:
Evan (Design): :thumbsup:
Jules (CS): :thumbsup: NDA question flagged, will ping legal if needed.
Priya (Eng): one blocker: if any partner needs on-prem deployment, timeline extends — call that out in intake.
Maya (PM): good call. i'll add a deployment-type field. thanks all.
